title: The 1972 Popular Revolution
description: On 13 May 1972, students and workers took to the streets of Antananarivo in a popular uprising that brought down President Philibert Tsiranana's government — widely regarded as independence in name only, having preserved French economic and administrative structures. The movement led to a military transitional government and a process of Malgachisation. It was a formative moment for an entire generation: the musicians of Mahaleo had helped inspire the protests with their songs, and the filmmakers who came of age in its wake carried its urgency into their work.
